title: Lighting and music at Lānaʻi hotel events
summary: At the October 21 meeting, a commissioner raised community concerns about lighting at a recent event approved with a minor permit. Staff said permit holders must follow the night sky lighting ordinance. In September, a commissioner said beach park rangers cannot enforce rules on the event's music and lighting, and a hotel representative said music at its events shuts down at 10 p.m.
